data.headline: Head of IT Procurement & Vendor Management at ICA Sverige | Driving Technology Value & Sourcing Strategy
data.about: Procurement leader with ten years building high-performing functions across direct manufacturing, indirect industrial and financial, and IT categories at Siemens, Atlas Copco and ICA. Documented +90 M€ in financial value through successive transformations by a strong procurement skill set and a proven leadership approach built on ownership and trust.  ________Leading IT sourcing of +160 M€ annual spend across the ICA Group, with accountability for ICA Sweden (+1200 retailers) and ICA Fastigheter, and the foundation IT for Apotek Hjärtat (+400 pharmacies), ICA Banken and ICA Försäkringar. Leading a ten-person specialist team of senior and junior IT sourcing managers, with full responsibility of sourcing strategy, team development, high-value complex RFx projects and negotiations. Focus areas are cost optimization, environmental compliance, IT delivery resilience, and large-scale transformations (+100 M€ initiatives).In 2024, I took on a team with low engagement, unclear mandate, and limited credibility with stakeholders after a large reorganization. Within 12 months, we had redesigned the sourcing model, launched an improvement program of our processes, rebuilt internal relationships, and begun repositioning us as a strategic business partner. The team went from reactive to proactive; delivering +35 M€ in financial value in the first full year of the transformation (2025). Leading this team as they reclaimed their confidence and delivered results of this magnitude, with ownership and dedication, is something I carry with genuine pride.

experiences.title: Head of IT Procurement and Vendor Management
experiences.subtitle: ICA Gruppen . Full-time
experiences.caption: Aug 2024 - Present · 1 yr 5 mos

description.text:
Leading IT sourcing of +160 M€ annual spend across the ICA Group, with accountability for ICA Sweden (+1200 retailers) and ICA Fastigheter, and the foundation IT for Apotek Hjärtat (+400 pharmacies), ICA Banken and ICA Försäkringar. Leading a ten-person specialist team of senior and junior IT sourcing managers, with full responsibility of sourcing strategy, team development, high-value complex RFx projects and negotiations. Focus areas are cost optimization, environmental compliance, IT delivery resilience, and large-scale transformations (+100 M€ initiatives).

In 2024, I took on a team with low engagement, unclear mandate, and limited credibility with stakeholders after a large reorganization. Within 12 months, we had redesigned the sourcing model, launched an improvement program of our processes, rebuilt internal relationships, and begun repositioning us as a strategic business partner. The team went from reactive to proactive; delivering +35 M€ in financial value in the first full year of the transformation (2025). 

Leading this team as they reclaimed their confidence and delivered results of this magnitude, with ownership and dedication, is something I carry with genuine pride. 

• Delivered +35 M€ in total financial value of savings and cost avoidance, representing +91 % of total indirect impact at ICA Sweden (2025)
• Retained 7 of 9 team members (one early resignation, one reorganization related exit), while recruiting three new team members (2024-2026)
• Increased the team’s engagement 70 % (49 to 83), goals and priorities 137 % (35 to 83), and team mandate 74 % (43 to 73) (2024-2026)
• Top scores on annual performance assessment (2025)

subComponents.title: Global Category Manager | Team Manager Strategic Sourcing | Indirect Material and Services
subComponents.caption: Dec 2021 - Jul 2024 · 2 yrs 7 mos

description.text:
Lead indirect sourcing of +110 M€ annual spend and a high-performing five-person team of indirect buyers of primarily professional service, IT, MRO, FM, energy, and factory spare parts. The team consistently surpassing annual targets and delivering results above expectations.

Built the team from the ground; recruitment, processes, strategies, and overall direction, and lead us in becoming specialists in strategic sourcing. Supervised sourcing strategies, RFx of strategic indirect sourcing projects and complex negotiations with well-known global and local suppliers, in collaboration with my dedicated category buyers and stakeholders in +20 countries.

• Built and retained a five-person team: recruited two, secured two transfers, and kept one original member throughout (2021-2024)
• Delivered +20 M€ in total financial value of savings and cost avoidance, lifting overall team target achievement by +260 % (2021-2024)
• Reduced supplier base with 33 %(+250 suppliers removed), and improved supplier base compliance from 90 % to +99 % (2021-2024)
• Top scores on annual performance assessment (2021-2023)

subComponents.title: Strategic IT Sourcing Lead | Acting Team Manager Indirect Materials and Services
subComponents.caption: Mar 2019 - Dec 2021 · 2 yrs 9 mos

description.text:
Managed IT sourcing of +40 M€ in annual spend, and served as a global advisor to Atlas Copco global executive management. Lead complex, end‑to‑end IT sourcing initiatives across the organization, supporting the realization of ITBA’s IT strategy; development of the new global B2B system tech stack, enhancing global sales capabilities, ERP and cloud infrastructure harmonization, collaborating with leading hyperscalers, shaping integration‑layer architecture. Drove IT sourcing activities; RFx, negotiations, contracts, governance, and sourcing strategy.
  
In 2020, appointed acting team manager for the strategic indirect sourcing team. Initiated the groundwork for rebuilding the sourcing function during the pandemic, work that formed the foundation for the full transformation delivered as Global Category Manager from 2021. 

• Supervised a master thesis about AI in strategic sourcing (2020)
• Lead a successful implementation of a spend analytics sourcing tool and governed the tool as super user (2020)
• Top scores on annual performance assessment (2019-2021)

experiences.title: Commodity Manager | Strategic Procurement | Direct Materials
experiences.subtitle: Siemens . Full-time
experiences.caption: Jan 2016 - Mar 2019 · 3 yrs 2 mos

description.text:
Managed three direct categories of +30 M€ annually for the Swedish site in Finspång, of advanced technology and core engine components of current and future fleet products. Managed commodity strategies, contract negotiations, RFx, vendor management, project management as both sponsor and lead, together with a global key commodity team of +15 strategic buyers and global suppliers.
  
Ranked Top Ten Negotiator out of +300 strategic buyers within Siemens Energy. Selected as one of the first ten members of Siemens AG’s global negotiation coaching initiative; traveling internationally to support complex, high-stakes negotiations. Also recognized as a Leader in the Digital Age, traveling across Europe to moderate sessions for strategic sourcing managers and key commodity managers.

experiences.title: President | Chairman of the Board
experiences.subtitle: Teknologkåren vid Luleå Tekniska Universitet . undefined
experiences.caption: Jul 2011 - Jun 2012 · 11 mos

description.text:
I served as President, overseeing and cultivating the engineering student union at Luleå University of Technology, comprising 1600 members, 700 volunteers, and a €1 million turnover.

The Vice President and I directly managed the registry office (3 FTEs) and the union's management board (5 FTEs), along with numerous elected volunteer roles across multiple internal associations. Our leadership strategy emphasized balancing entrepreneurship with risk management; This was essential as the student union's operations included several administrative bodies, organizational employees, many motivated volunteers, and bigger projects. Ensuring robust internal communication and motivation within the executive board was a notable challenge, but it's a work I am proud to carry with me.

Served as a student representative on the Board of Directors at Luleå University of Technology (LTU), representing the engineering students (B.Sc/M.Sc). Participating in strategic decision making at the highest governance level of the university, brining student perspectives to discussions on education quality, campus development, and institutional priorities and strategic direction.

experiences.title: Army Officer | Deputy Platoon Commander | 2nd Lieutenant
experiences.subtitle: Försvarsmakten . undefined
experiences.caption: Jan 2008 - Dec 2008 · 11 mos

description.text:
Served as Deputy Platoon Commander, Second Lieutenant, and Instructor in the Reconnaissance Platoon (I19 / 141st Armored Battalion), following promotion from Sergeant after completing conscript training. Took on broad leadership and instructional responsibilities at both platoon and company level, including field command duties. Developed deep competence in applied leadership, leadership psychology, and team development. 

Lead the platoon through harsh conditions and extreme physical and psychological challenges for one year; requiring continuous coaching, motivation, prioritization, and clear decision‑making under heavy time pressure. Guided both myself and the platoon to consistently meet and exceed mission goals despite demanding stress, tough targets and weather conditions. Proud of the platoon’s strong development and performance during this period, with a great end performance result.

Served as a conscript scout in the Reconnaissance Platoon of the 142nd Armored Battalion (I19) from 2006 to 2007. Selected as one of Platoon Commanders, and completed service with the rank of Sergeant. Awarded the platoon’s “Best Prospective Commander,” and together with my reconnaissance combat vehicle crew, named “Battalion’s Best Soldiers” after the Swedish Army’s final military exercise Combined Challenge.

Developed strong foundations in applied leadership, teamwork, and situational decision‑making under extreme physical and psychological pressure. Learned to overcome psychological barriers and lead effectively with limited time, sleep, motivation, and energy, as well as in challenging weather and field conditions. Built confidence in what a motivated team can achieve; proving that with hard work, discipline, and mutual trust, almost any task is manageable. Proud of the platoon’s progress, cohesion, and performance throughout the year.

subComponents.text: Negotiation Mastery is an 8-week online certificate program from Harvard Business School. Negotiation Mastery prepares students to close deals that might otherwise be dead-locked, maximize value creation in agreements, and resolve differences before they escalate into costly conflicts. The program provides both an analytical toolkit and interpersonal techniques for dealing effectively with different bargaining styles and tactics. Negotiation Mastery was developed by leading Harvard Business School faculty and is delivered in an active learning environment based on the HBS signature case-based learning model.
